purpose: Fresh clean proof of multi-source runtime group-by/count reduction, XLSX materialization, and independent aggregate verification.
goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/REDUCE_USERS.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/REDUCE_USERS.json. Using a real rendered browser, open https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/REDUCE_POSTS.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/REDUCE_POSTS.json. Using both live results, create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/USER_POST_COUNTS.json containing exactly one record per live user with user_id, username, and post_count, where post_count is the number of live posts whose userId equals that user's id. Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/USER_POST_COUNTS.xlsx from canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/USER_POST_COUNTS.json with columns user_id, username, and post_count. Independently reread both live source results, the summary JSON, and the XLSX and verify every live user appears exactly once, each username is correct, each post_count exactly matches the live posts, the sum of post_count equals the live post count, there are no extra records, and the XLSX is identical to the summary JSON.
